name: review-moderation
description: E-commerce: publish, hide or escalate product reviews under a store policy.

action.instructions: Apply the store's review policy to `review`. What should happen to it?

criteria.publish: An honest experience with the product, seller or delivery, including harsh negative opinions and very short reviews.
criteria.hide: Contains personal contact details or addresses, threats or slurs, advertising or links, admits being paid or rewarded, or reviews a product the writer has not received.
criteria.review: Serious factual accusations against the brand that a person should check before publishing.
